waste.qualifier: The FOEN comparator covers a broader household edible-discard basket than Staple’s planned shop.

choiceExample.note: Coverage is the in-app weekly micronutrient coverage score. It is not MAR-10.
choiceExample.unit: CHF / week, mean of the eight-week replay for Budget; Quality is the replay quality policy.

frontier.note: Full non-dominated set from the default live-engine run used for the product screenshots. Duplicate chart coordinates are collapsed. Highlighted points are the three plans surfaced in the app.

sources.habe: BFS Household Budget Survey (HABE), COICOP 01 food at home, single-adult grocery CHF 13.65/day.
sources.menuCh: FSVO/BLV menuCH 2014–15, n = 2,057 adults aged 18–75. MAR-10 Swiss mean 74.2%.
sources.foen: FOEN household edible discard, ~90 kg/person/year (~1,731 g/week). Broader than a planned grocery basket.
sources.system: System documentation: Apple Health via Shortcut for energy and body weight; Swiss Food Composition Database V7.1 for nutrient values; current grocery prices and dated pantry events for the weekly plan.
sources.optimizer: Optimizer documentation: seeded whole-week search; live local grocery price and promotion overlay; whole-package till cost net of pantry; hard nutrition and cooking floors; Budget, Balanced and Quality plans drawn from the options no other plan beats on both cost and nutrition; learned weights pick between them.
sources.protocol: Frozen confirmatory protocol: primary outcomes, matched computational baselines, mechanism ablations, predefined scenarios, stress tests and holdout evaluation. The August 2026 replay remains pilot development data.
sources.nutrients: Ten MAR-10 components shown as raw percent of reference before the MAR-10 cap: protein, fiber, calcium, magnesium, iron, zinc, vitamins A, C and B12, and folate. Staple values are eight-week replay means. menuCH context is shown where the compiled survey mean is available; Vitamin A is not available in the frozen comparator.

caveats: The analysis is a preliminary deterministic engine replay for one fixed adult scenario; results are point estimates.
No sampling process was modeled, and confidence or uncertainty intervals are not reported.
Price inputs comprise four local grocery pulls collected from 16 to 19 August 2026; seasonal, geographic and retailer variation were not evaluated.
The eight weeks are sequential and share pantry state; they are not independent observations.
Household spending, dietary-survey and waste estimates are contextual comparators drawn from different populations and measurement frames; reported differences are not causal effects.
The household waste comparator covers a broader edible-discard basket than Staple’s modeled planned shop.
This was not a feeding or purchasing trial. Adherence, realized expenditure, realized waste and health outcomes were not measured.
This is a technical snapshot as of 19 August 2026. The algorithm, catalog, recipes, prices and outputs may change.
